description.en: Shorthand for CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_Animal with its _no_bustup argument forced to true — creates a low-detail animal-type NPC model without its bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC number used to build the model's file path.
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail animal-type NPC model without a bustup portrait
local hAnimalL = CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_AnimalNoBustup("animalL", 5);
